title: Overlapping global and cue limits are not enforced together
summary: The victim selector steals a low-priority voice outside the full cue, leaving two voices for a cue capped at one while the global cap remains respected. Ancestor bus aggregation is a separate policy question.
review_note: Independent evidence review confirmed the bounded cap violation; downgraded High to Medium. Ancestor cap inheritance is not explicitly promised.

title: Bar transitions miss boundaries crossed by a long frame
summary: At 60 BPM, schedule bar transition from scene one after update at position 0, then move leader to 5.1 seconds. Bar 1 is emitted but the transition remains pending in scene one.

title: Looping music stops emitting beats after the first playback cycle
summary: Default music layers loop. Advance leader to 3.9, wrap to 0.1, then advance to 1.1. Beat count stays 4 because runtime.beat retains the previous cycle maximum.

title: Loop regions are ignored when a scene has no BPM
summary: Create an immediate scene with loopRegion={start=1,finish=2}, no BPM or analysis, and a source at 2.1. update leaves its position at 2.1 instead of seeking to 1.

title: snapshot analysis state is not detached
summary: Assign snapshot.analysis.fake="corrupted", then take another snapshot. The new snapshot contains fake="corrupted" because analysis returns the internal status table directly.
